mechanistic_chain: BUBR1 with BUB3 MAD2 and CDC20 forms the MCC; MCC restrains APC/C before chromosome attachment is satisfied; biallelic BUB1B disruption has been observed in constitutional mosaic aneuploidy.
qualification: Original BUB1B family study establishes genotype-disease association; it does not establish the functional effect of every possible allele. Original article accessible here only through its journal full-text rendering.

mechanistic_chain: MAD1 recruits MAD2 at unattached kinetochores; MAD2 contributes to the APC/C-inhibitory MCC; biallelic MAD1L1 variants have been accompanied by deficient SAC response and mosaic aneuploidy.
evidence_scope: Single reported biallelic human case with cell assays; biochemical MCC assay
qualification: MAD1 is a checkpoint recruiter not a purified MCC core subunit; single published family does not establish prevalence or variant-general effects.

mechanistic_chain: TRIP13 with p31comet disassembles MAD2-containing checkpoint complexes; recycling of MAD2 also sustains checkpoint signalling before attachment. Biallelic TRIP13 loss in patient cells impairs SAC and segregation; wild-type re-expression rescues both.
evidence_scope: Patient lymphoblast rescue; in-vitro complex disassembly
qualification: Do not infer that blocking checkpoint disassembly alone explains loss-of-function phenotypes: TRIP13 has opposing phase-dependent SAC roles.

pathway_node: centrosome microtubule anchorage and kinetochore link
mechanistic_chain: CEP57 contributes to centrosomal microtubule nucleation/anchorage; biallelic loss-of-function associates with constitutional mosaic aneuploidy. In cultured human cells CEP57 also binds MIS12 and MAD1 and supports kinetochore MAD1-MAD2 localisation.
evidence_scope: Affected families; human-cell RNAi and rescue
qualification: The kinetochore result comes from cell depletion, not proof that a specific patient allele disrupts this interaction; TRIP13 comparison found minimal SAC deficiency in CEP57 patient cells.

mechanistic_chain: Biallelic CENATAC/CCDC84 truncation associates with mosaic aneuploidy; CENATAC depletion or disease alleles cause selective AT-AN U12 intron retention and chromosome congression errors; wild type but not disease alleles rescues cellular defects.
evidence_scope: Human affected families and cultured cell perturbation/rescue
qualification: Splicing-to-chromosome mechanism is supported but specific causal mis-spliced target gene(s) are not identified; CENATAC is not thereby proven a kinetochore or MCC core protein.

mechanistic_chain: BUB1 abundance supports kinetochore recruitment of BUBR1; BUB1 kinase activity supports centromeric Aurora B SGO1 and TOP2A recruitment. Biallelic human BUB1 variants caused mitotic segregation and cohesion defects.
evidence_scope: Two human cases with cellular assays
qualification: These cells retained an overall functional spindle assembly checkpoint; do not equate BUB1 loss with complete SAC failure or established classical MVA.

mechanistic_chain: p31comet recruits TRIP13 to MAD2-containing complexes for SAC silencing; homozygous MAD2L1BP truncations have been associated with mosaic aneuploidy; recombinant C-terminal truncation loses efficient TRIP13 binding and fails to support normal complex disassembly.
evidence_scope: Small human families with patient-derived cells and recombinant truncation tests
qualification: A targeted extension beyond preregistered Tier 1; limited families and variant-specific effects; not a measured case-level score.
